evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the business expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/business.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area business, metadata.author forjate:business, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Three stages, one KPI name across them, cost per stage within the lab/mvp/production envelopes, as-is exceptions, Odoo as system of record, a metric gate at Crawl, at least one open question (cost of a wrong amount, exception SLA).

assertions.text: business.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case
decides for all three in-scope stages

assertions.expr: all(not choices(s) for s in stages)
assertions.text: choice is empty: business picks no components
one KPI name shared by every stage

assertions.expr: all(st(s).get('estimated_cost_usd_month') is not None for s in stages)
assertions.text: cost estimated for every stage
crawl is lab-cheap and run carries the production envelope

assertions.expr: any(has('odoo', x) for x in listed(setting('systems_of_record', 'crawl')))
assertions.text: Odoo named as a system of record
at least two as-is exceptions reconstructed
value hypothesis carries a number

assertions.expr: all(setting('go_no_go', s) in ('go', 'conditional', 'no-go') for s in stages)
assertions.text: go/no-go stated per stage

assertions.expr: any(((g.get('check') or {}).get('type')) == 'metric' for g in gates('crawl'))
assertions.text: crawl gate measures the KPI (metric check)
raises at least one open question the brief cannot answer

evals.name: adversarial-fte-claim
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/support-copilot.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/support-copilot.yaml to stage-plan.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there with an empty pack list (spec.packs: []) and set spec.context_packs to [] in the brief. The head of CS insists the pilot saves 2 FTE from day one, that Crawl should be skipped to start directly at Walk, and that no baseline is needed; the record should say so. Then, as the business expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/decisions/business.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area business, metadata.author forjate:business, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Crawl kept (the planner owns scope), the 2 FTE claim rejected in alternatives or risks with the derivation from 200 messages/day, baseline kept from the brief.

assertions.text: business.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case
Crawl kept despite the request to skip it

assertions.expr: any(has('fte|full.time', a.get('rejected_because')) or has('fte|full.time', a.get('option')) for a in alts()) or any(has('fte|full.time', r.get('text')) for r in risks()) or any(has('fte|full.time', q.get('question')) for q in oq())
assertions.text: the 2 FTE claim is rejected or questioned, not signed
hypothesis derived from the brief's volume (200 messages/day)
baseline kept from the brief, not dropped

Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/packs/cost-cap (name cost-cap) and set spec.context_packs to [cost-cap] in the brief. Then, as the business expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/business.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area business, metadata.author forjate:business, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.

assertions.text: business.yaml written

validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: all(setting('payback_months', s) is not None for s in stages)
assertions.text: payback_months present in every stage (COST-2)
COST-1 cited in constrained_by
COST-2 cited in constrained_by
open question raised with caused_by_rule pack:cost-cap#COST-1
walk is not an unconditional go under the cap
